Styles of dynamic spectrograms

Source: R/styles.R
styles.Rd

Set the style of a dynaspec() object:

  • ds_scrolling(): the spectrogram scrolls from right to left past the play line, which stays at the center (it only moves at the start and the end, while the spectrogram is still, so the window shown is always full of sound; see 'still.ends').

  • ds_paged(): the spectrogram is split into pages, and a translucent box reveals the part of each page being played.

  • ds_static(): a play line moves over the whole spectrogram (and oscillogram), which can be split in several rows (default style).

Usage

ds_scrolling(
  t.display = 1.5,
  still.ends = TRUE,
  fix.time = TRUE,
  buffer = 0,
  loop = 1,
  speed = 1,
  width = 700,
  height = 400,
  res = 70,
  fps = 50,
  parallel = 1,
  ...
)

ds_paged(
  t.display = NULL,
  title = NULL,
  highlight.alpha = 0.6,
  legend = FALSE,
  width = 1350,
  height = 450,
  res = 150,
  fps = 30,
  parallel = 1,
  ...
)

ds_static(
  rows = 1,
  width = 1000,
  height = 500,
  res = 100,
  alt = NULL,
  fps = 30,
  play.line = TRUE,
  ...
)

Arguments

t.display

Time (in s) shown at once: the time window of scrolling spectrograms (default 1.5) or the duration of each page of paged spectrograms (default: the whole sound, up to 5 s).

still.ends

Logical: keep the window shown within the sound in scrolling spectrograms? With TRUE the spectrogram is still at the start, while the play line moves from the left edge to the center, then scrolls with the line at the center, and is still again at the end, while the line moves to the right edge (so the window never shows the empty room before the start or after the end of the sound). With FALSE the line stays at the center and the sound enters from the center and leaves at the center. Looping spectrograms (loop > 1) always scroll continuously. Default is TRUE.

fix.time

Logical: does the time axis stay fixed (TRUE, default) or move along with the scrolling spectrogram?

buffer

Time (in s) before the scrolling spectrogram starts moving. Default is 0.

loop

Number of times the sound is repeated in scrolling videos (web pages loop until paused when > 1). Default is 1.

speed

Playback speed of videos of scrolling spectrograms (e.g. 0.5 for half speed). Web pages start at the first speed of ds_player() ('speeds'), as in all styles. Default is 1.

width, height, res

Size (in pixels) and resolution of the figures: frames of scrolling spectrograms (defaults 700, 400 and 70), pages of paged spectrograms (defaults 1350, 450 and 150; web pages show them at a higher resolution), and each row of static spectrograms (defaults 1000, 500 and 100).

fps

Frames per second of videos. Defaults are 50 (scrolling) and 30 (paged and static).

parallel

Number of cores used to render videos of scrolling and paged spectrograms. Default is 1.

...

Other arguments of the style:

  • ds_static(): none.

  • ds_scrolling(): 'ggspectro' (use seewave::ggspectro(); default FALSE), 'derivative' (spectral derivatives; requires 'imager'; default FALSE) and 'spectro.call' (a call to a spectrogram function replacing the default one, made with base::call()).

  • ds_paged(): 'resample.rate' (sampling rate in Hz used for the spectrogram; default 15000), 'amp.thresh' (amplitude threshold, as a percentage; default 0), 'dest.path' (folder for temporary files) and 'delete.temp' (delete temporary files; default TRUE).

title

Title of paged spectrograms.

highlight.alpha

Opacity of the highlight box of paged spectrograms (default 0.6).

legend

Logical: show the amplitude color scale of paged spectrograms? Default is FALSE.

rows

Number of rows in which static spectrograms are split (each row shows a consecutive segment of the same duration). Default is 1.

alt

Alternative text of static spectrograms in web pages (for screen readers).

play.line

Logical: show the line moving along the sound in static spectrograms? With FALSE web pages show the figure without the moving line (clicking on it still plays the sound from that point) and videos show the figure with the sound. Default is TRUE.

Value

A layer to be added to a dynaspec() object with +.

Details

Only the arguments supplied are used; other settings take the defaults shown.

Only the arguments supplied are used: the defaults shown are those of each style, which apply when an argument is not supplied (adding the style again keeps the arguments supplied before and changes those supplied again).

The play line (its color, type and width) and the color of the highlight box of paged spectrograms are set with ds_theme() ('col.line', 'lty.line', 'lwd.line' and 'col.highlight'), for all styles.

See also

dynaspec(), save_dynaspec(), ds_theme()

Examples

data(scythebill)

x <- dynaspec(scythebill, flim = c(1.5, 5.5)) +
  ds_spectrogram(wl.ms = 18, collevels = seq(-50, 0, 1))

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
data(antshrike)
y <- dynaspec(antshrike, flim = c(0.5, 5.5)) +
  ds_spectrogram(wl.ms = 23, collevels = seq(-50, 0, 1))
y + ds_scrolling(t.display = 2, axis.type = "minimal")
x + ds_paged(t.display = 1, axis.type = "standard")
x + ds_oscillogram() + ds_static(rows = 2, height = 350)
x + ds_theme(col.line = "red", lty.line = "dashed", lwd.line = 3)
} # }
